description: Random pair splits let the same drug appear in training and test, so a model can score by recognising drugs rather than generalising.
mitigation_in_this_study: Split by drug, not pair. Leakage auditor verifies train/test drug sets are disjoint. S3 subset reported separately.
residual_risk: Drug-disjoint does not prevent a test drug sharing a Bemis-Murcko scaffold with a training drug; scaffold-disjoint was not evaluated.

description: If known interactions entered the biological representation, the model would see its own labels.
mitigation_in_this_study: biology.py never opens ddi_positive_labels.parquet and never reads a split assignment. Zero DDI edges in the biological branch.
residual_risk: None identified. The guarantee is structural rather than procedural.

description: Uniform negative sampling lets a model score by asking whether both drugs are promiscuous.
mitigation_in_this_study: Degree-matched negative sampling; degree computed from training pairs only.
residual_risk: Degree matching is an assumption; a different scheme defines a different task. Lower reported numbers are the intended cost.

description: Well-studied drugs have more annotations and more documented interactions, so a biological gain may reflect study intensity.
mitigation_in_this_study: CONTROL A (count-only RF, 0.6504) and CONTROL F (degree-preserving identity shuffle, 0.6923) both fall far below M4 (0.8117).
residual_risk: Controls address the count dimension. They do not exclude that annotation identity is itself distributed non-randomly with respect to study intensity.

description: A shuffle that leaves structure intact would understate the identity effect.
mitigation_in_this_study: Stratified degree-preserving double-edge swap; 97.47% of edges changed; both degree sequences preserved exactly; stricter than the preregistered uniform resampling.
residual_risk: 2,255 edges (2.53%) retained unchanged; protein-to-pathway edges not shuffled at all.

description: Repeated test evaluation inflates apparent performance.
mitigation_in_this_study: Hyperparameters selected on validation across 96 runs; test opened once; frozen config file records that the test set was not used for selection.
residual_risk: Ablations and controls were evaluated on the same frozen test set; Holm correction across five hypotheses addresses multiplicity for the preregistered comparisons only.

description: Five hypotheses on one test set inflate the chance of a false positive.
mitigation_in_this_study: Holm-Bonferroni across all five preregistered hypotheses, including the exploratory H5, which makes the correction stricter for the four confirmatory ones.
residual_risk: Post-hoc analyses (ablation ladder shape, modality reliance) are not corrected and are labelled post-hoc.

description: Five seeds give limited power and cannot support a normality check.
mitigation_in_this_study: Paired tests by seed; effect sizes reported; bootstrap over test pairs for H1 and H3 as an independent check.
residual_risk: n=5 cannot verify the t-test's distributional assumption. Seeds vary training stochasticity only, not the split or drug universe.

description: Results may be specific to one partition of drugs.
mitigation_in_this_study: Split seed fixed and preregistered; five model seeds on that split.
residual_risk: No cross-split replication was performed. Reported SDs do not estimate variability across drug universes.

description: About 86.8% of the pair space is unlabelled, not negative, so some sampled negatives are undocumented true interactions.
mitigation_in_this_study: Stated explicitly; negative generation treated as a first-class methodological choice with its own module and tests.
residual_risk: Magnitude of label noise is unknown and depresses apparent performance by an unquantified amount.

description: 1,705 TDC-selected drugs are a subset of DrugBank's ~15,000, chosen by unknown upstream criteria.
mitigation_in_this_study: Stated explicitly in Methods and Limitations; no claim of representativeness.
residual_risk: Conclusions may not transfer to the full DrugBank universe or to other interaction resources.

description: Perturbation attribution can be read as causal pharmacology.
mitigation_in_this_study: Terminology fixed as model reliance; explicit statement that perturbations do not establish causal mechanisms; frozen output carries its own interpretation rule.
residual_risk: Readers may still over-read attribution results; the risk is mitigated by wording, not eliminated.

description: A probe whose held-out target has zero variance yields an undefined R^2 that could be misread as evidence of absence.
mitigation_in_this_study: Verified directly that held-out target variance is exactly 0; reported as undefined; r2_test=0.0 identified as a placeholder.
residual_risk: The planned diagnostic provides no held-out evidence at all. CONTROL F carries the load instead.

description: Raw neural probabilities are poorly calibrated and could be over-interpreted.
mitigation_in_this_study: Temperature scaling fitted on validation only; ECE reduced roughly threefold; ranking unchanged by construction.
residual_risk: Calibrated probabilities remain research predictions with no clinical validation.

threat: Post-hoc explanation of the ablation shape
description: Explaining why M2 beats M4 after seeing the result risks storytelling.
mitigation_in_this_study: The shape of the ladder was not preregistered; all explanations are explicitly labelled post-hoc and offered as hypotheses for future work.
